description: This file defines the class Vtiger_PDF_InventoryFooterViewer, which manages the display of footer content in PDF inventory reports, including handling layout and content for description and terms & conditions sections.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_InventoryFooterViewer
classes.description: A class specialized in rendering footer sections of inventory PDFs, including description and terms & conditions, with methods for calculating total height and displaying content.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Calculates the total height of the footer section based on the content of description and terms & conditions, adjusting for page layout.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the footer content into the PDF, including description and terms & conditions with appropriate layout and styling.
